views.group_body:
Use `{prefix}giveaway start` to start a new giveaway.
Use `{prefix}giveaway ban <member>` to keep a member out of every giveaway in this server, and `{prefix}giveaway unban <member>` to let them back in.

views.reroll_hint: -# Reroll with `{command}` — copy and paste it here.
views.reroll_announce: {giveaway} **Giveaway Reroll!** The new winner for **{prize}** is: {mentions}! Congratulations!
